scoring_justification: Transition pressure is compared against a hidden paper-reported value with tolerance (T0); anisotropy trend is verified by structural audit (T3). A full recompute from the agent's raw DFT outputs is not feasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference transition pressure for B1→B2 phase transition in SrO
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: 'Present' column for P_t (transition pressure) is 35.8 GPa.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published result.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the actual published value; the checker compares the agent's computed result against it with tolerance.

schema.description: At least 50 rows covering p_z from 0.0 to 5.0 a.u.

outputs.description: Directional Compton profile anisotropy curves. The checker will verify physical consistency of the curves.

schema.description: A single floating-point number (the transition pressure in GPa).

outputs.description: The B1→B2 phase transition pressure in GPa. Checker compares against a hidden reference value with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The reproduction uses Quantum ESPRESSO instead of the paper's CRYSTAL code to avoid proprietary software. The Compton profiles computation may involve custom post‑processing (e.g. QE pp module or custom scripts). The Birch–Murnaghan fitting can be performed with standard Python libraries.

steps.description: Verify structural properties: for p_z in [0,3] a.u. delta_110_111 is never larger than both delta_100_110 and delta_100_111 (i.e., it is the smallest), and at p_z=0.2 a.u. all three values are positive.
Compare reported B1→B2 transition pressure to the paper-reported value of 35.8 GPa with tolerance ±5 GPa.
